shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n' && for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/loading.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -120; printf '\\n--- tree ---\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | head -200"

/bin/bash -c "cat CLAUDE.md && printf '\\n--- GEMINI ---\\n' && cat GEMINI.md && printf '\\n--- git diff package ---\\n' && git diff -- package.json && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md; printf '\\n--- fetch guide relevant ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md; printf '\\n--- use cache sections ---\\n'; sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md; sed -n '680,760p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md; printf '\\n--- cache components config ---\\n'; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg 'cacheComponents|loading\\.md|layout\\.md' | head -50"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '90,145p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && printf '\\n--- fetch memoization docs ---\\n' && sed -n '42,78p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && printf '\\n--- cache components ---\\n' && sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- loading docs ---\\n' && sed -n '36,90p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md"
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && git status --short'
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && printf '\\n--- final source diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx"
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff --check && git diff --stat'
/bin/bash -c 'git clean -fd -- .next/ next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat'
